info.title: Moss HTTP API
info.description: Controller API of Moss. Base path /api/v1. Authenticate with a Supabase access token or a Moss API token (`moss_pat_…`) as a Bearer token. Shapes are summarised here; docs/api.md has the prose reference.

remote_destination.description: name of the destination holding the remote copy

local_present.description: false when only the remote copy remains; preview and download then answer 409 backup.remote_only until it is fetched

BackupDestination.description: A place backups are copied to. Credentials are write-only: access_key and secret_key read back as "set" or "not set".

keep_local.description: 0 keeps every local copy; N keeps the newest N local archives once their remote copy is verified

keep_remote.description: newest remote copies to keep (at least 1; locked backups and the newest good copy are never removed)

stored_backups.description: list only: backups currently stored here

StagedRestore.description: A restore extracted next to the live server and waiting for an explicit promote. Detail (checks, diff) is present once status is ready.

slug.description: 3 to 40 characters of a-z, 0-9 and dashes

show_address.description: Owner-entered public address shown on the page

players.description: Only when the page shows players

trigger.description: An event type from the webhook event list

server_ids.description: Empty = every server the creator can manage

condition.description: {field, op, value}; fields players.online, players.max, player, server, detail, data.<path>

actions.description: Ordered: start|stop|restart|backup {server}, command {server, command}, wait {seconds<=600}, notify {title, body}, webhook {url | endpoint_id}. server is "trigger" or a server id; commands may use {player} {server} {event} {online} {max}
